title: Signing Exposure Schedule: Kestrel Share Purchase Agreement

notes.heading: Basis of preparation
notes.text: This exposure schedule was prepared by the Transaction Services team as at the Execution Date of the Share Purchase Agreement relating to Kestrel Components Private Limited, to summarise the financial protections and thresholds agreed at signing. Amounts are stated in Indian rupees as whole numbers, percentages are stated as a percentage of the Purchase Consideration, and survival periods are stated in months from the Completion Date unless otherwise noted. The schedule reflects the signing position only and has not been updated for any amendment agreement executed after the Execution Date, so users should check the current transaction documents before relying on any figure.
